cards.example_en: The customer asked for a larger size and left the small shirt.
cards.example_zh: 那位顾客要了更大的尺码，把小衬衫留下了。

cards.example_en: Cut the apple into four pieces for the children.
cards.example_zh: 把苹果切成四块分给孩子们。

cards.example_en: The panda in the photo looks cute.
cards.example_zh: 照片里的熊猫很可爱。

cards.example_en: Daily practice on the violin has improved her tone.
cards.example_zh: 每天练小提琴让她的音色变好了。

cards.example_en: The lantern dance closed the show and everyone clapped.
cards.example_zh: 灯笼舞蹈为演出收了尾，大家都鼓了掌。

cards.example_en: Black ice on the cycle path put the morning riders in danger.
cards.example_zh: 骑行道上的薄冰让早晨的骑行者陷入了危险。

cards.example_en: It's dangerous to swim here.
cards.example_zh: 在这里游泳很危险。

cards.example_en: The room is dark.
cards.example_zh: 房间是黑暗的。

cards.example_en: Write the date in the top right corner of the test paper.
cards.example_zh: 把日期写在试卷的右上角。

cards.example_en: Their daughter teaches piano to three children from our street.
cards.example_zh: 他们的女儿教我们这条街上的三个孩子弹钢琴。

cards.example_en: On the hottest day, the canteen gave out free ice lollies.
cards.example_zh: 最热的那天，食堂免费发了冰棍。

cards.example_en: Dead leaves were swept into piles along the garden path.
cards.example_zh: 枯叶被扫成一堆一堆，沿着花园小径堆好。

cards.example_en: The school offers a club for deaf students.
cards.example_zh: 学校为聋人学生开设了一个社团。

cards.example_en: I got a good deal on a second-hand bike at the school sale.
cards.example_zh: 我在学校义卖上买二手自行车，成交很划算。

cards.example_en: Dear friends, welcome to our show.
cards.example_zh: 亲爱的朋友们，欢迎来看我们的演出。

cards.example_en: The novel ends soon after the death of the loyal dog.
cards.example_zh: 那只忠犬死亡后不久，小说就结束了。

cards.example_en: Decide which club you want to join before Friday.
cards.example_zh: 星期五之前，先决定你想加入哪个社团。

cards.example_en: The pond is deep at the far end, so swimming is banned there.
cards.example_zh: 池塘远端水深，所以那里禁止游泳。

cards.example_en: The degree of noise in the canteen makes talking almost impossible.
cards.example_zh: 食堂里噪音的程度大到几乎没法说话。

cards.example_en: The soup smells delicious.
cards.example_zh: 这汤闻起来很香。

cards.example_en: I have an appointment with the dentist.
cards.example_zh: 我和牙医有个约会。

cards.example_en: Our picnic plans depend on clear weather this weekend.
cards.example_zh: 我们的野餐安排取决于这个周末是否放晴。

cards.example_en: Describe your bedroom in five clear sentences.
cards.example_zh: 用五个清楚的句子描述一下你的卧室。

cards.example_en: Camels can walk for days in the desert.
cards.example_zh: 骆驼能在沙漠里走好几天。

cards.example_en: Our group will design a poster for sports day.
cards.example_zh: 我们小组要为运动会设计一张海报。

cards.example_en: I found my lost ruler under the desk after everyone had left.
cards.example_zh: 大家都走了以后，我在书桌底下找到了丢失的尺子。

cards.example_en: Daily practice can develop your football skills.
cards.example_zh: 每天练习能够提升你的足球技术。

cards.example_en: Read the dialogue aloud with a partner.
cards.example_zh: 和搭档大声读这段对话。

cards.example_en: I write in my diary every night.
cards.example_zh: 我每天晚上都写日记。

cards.example_en: Look up the word in a dictionary.
cards.example_zh: 在词典里查这个词。

cards.example_en: These plants die quickly without water in summer.
cards.example_zh: 这些植物在夏天缺水会很快枯死。

cards.example_en: The nurse suggested a diet with more vegetables and less fried food.
cards.example_zh: 护士建议饮食里多吃蔬菜，少吃油炸食品。

cards.example_en: Can you tell the difference between the two pictures?
cards.example_zh: 你能分辨出这两张照片的区别吗？

cards.example_en: The two pictures look different.
cards.example_zh: 这两幅图看起来不一样。

cards.example_en: I believe that he still finished it on time even though the task was difficult.
cards.example_zh: 我相信，尽管任务很艰巨，他还是按时完成了。

cards.example_en: We dig small holes for trees behind the gym.
cards.example_zh: 我们在体育馆后面挖小坑种树。

cards.example_en: We use a digital clock in class.
cards.example_zh: 我们课上用数字时钟。

cards.example_en: Dining at my aunt's house always means too much food and loud talk.
cards.example_zh: 在姨妈家用餐，总是菜多得吃不完，说话也很大声。

cards.example_en: Dinner was fish and rice, with watermelon for anyone still hungry.
cards.example_zh: 晚餐是鱼和米饭，没吃饱的人还有西瓜。

cards.example_en: Is there a direct train from our town to the capital?
cards.example_zh: 从我们镇到首都有直达火车吗？

cards.example_en: The factory director stopped the line when a belt began to smoke.
cards.example_zh: 传送带开始冒烟时，工厂主管停下了生产线。

cards.example_en: Dirty boots were left outside so the kitchen floor stayed clean.
cards.example_zh: 脏靴子放在门外，厨房地板才保持干净。

cards.example_en: I don't want to disappoint my coach.
cards.example_zh: 我不想让教练失望。

cards.example_en: Forgetting the cakes at home turned the party into a small disaster.
cards.example_zh: 蛋糕忘在家里，聚会变成了一场小灾祸。

cards.example_en: Scientists discover new facts every year.
cards.example_zh: 科学家每年都发现新的事实。

cards.example_en: Let's discuss the picnic menu during lunch break.
cards.example_zh: 午休时，我们来讨论一下野餐的菜单吧。

cards.example_en: The vet isolated the hen so the disease would not reach the others.
cards.example_zh: 兽医把那只母鸡隔开，免得病传到其余的鸡身上。

cards.example_en: The potato dish from the canteen sold out before noon.
cards.example_zh: 食堂的土豆菜肴中午之前就卖完了。

cards.example_en: Divide the cake into eight equal pieces.
cards.example_zh: 把蛋糕分成八等份。

cards.example_en: I do my maths homework at the kitchen table.
cards.example_zh: 我在厨房的桌子上做数学作业。

word.example_en: The storm cut off the power.
We should cut down on plastic bags.
This map is out of date.
This shop does not deal in phones.
I do not know how to deal with this noise.
word.example_zh: 我不知道怎么处理这噪音。

word.example_en: Plants depend on water and light.
In old stories, people die of a high fever.
word.example_zh: 旧故事里，人会死于高烧。

word.example_en: Some animals may die out if we do nothing.
word.example_zh: 如果我们什么都不做，有些动物可能会灭绝。

word.example_en: People can die from a bad accident.
A kind word can make a difference.
word.example_zh: 一句善意的话也能有影响。

word.example_en: The two cities are different in climate.
word.example_zh: 这两座城市在气候上不一样。

word.example_en: City life is different from life in a town.
word.example_zh: 城市生活与小镇生活不同。

word.example_en: They do their best on the oral test.
word.example_zh: 他们在口试上尽自己最大努力。

word.example_en: We do sports on the school field.
word.example_zh: 我们在学校操场进行体育活动。

word.example_en: She can do well in history.
They do homework in the study room.
The school will do away with paper tickets.
